entries.title: Search Orbis from one place
entries.description: You can search posts and threads from your home feed alongside people, communities, titles, and your library in one search window. Switch to searching the page you’re on, or revisit recent searches and results.

entries.title: Crop your pictures before saving
entries.description: You can position and zoom your avatar, community icon, or profile and community cover before saving it. Drag to move the image and use the zoom slider, scroll wheel, or a pinch to frame it.

entries.title: Choose which communities see your library updates
entries.description: You can turn library sharing off for each community in your member settings. Your updates stop appearing in that community’s feed and reaching its members through Home, while remaining on your profile.

entries.title: Keep up with what’s new in Orbis
entries.description: You can browse and search daily updates in the changelog. A note on Home highlights the latest changes; you can dismiss an update or turn these notes off in settings.

entries.title: See verification badges for people and communities
entries.description: You can spot verified people and communities by the badge beside their names on profiles, community pages, search results, and lists. Friends’ badges update when their verification changes.

entries.title: Find settings in clearer tabs
entries.description: You can switch between General, Privacy, Connections, and Account tabs in your settings. Your personal community settings also separate your nickname and library sharing controls into Profile and Privacy tabs.

entries.title: Clearer guidance for joining conversations
entries.description: You can see why a like is unavailable when friendship or community membership is required. Profile walls also explain how to join the conversation, with buttons to add a friend or accept their request.

entries.title: More helpful library dock navigation
entries.description: You can reach site links from the library dock’s footer. On your library page, the dock stays closed and its handle explains that your library is already open.

entries.title: A tidier stream countdown
entries.description: You can see a compact countdown on community pages and hover over it for the stream title and scheduled time.
